choices.reasoning: Mulligan Repulsor Blast: attack event not wanted in opening hand when Iron Man needs Tech upgrades and setup cards.
Mulligan Avengers Mansion: cost 4 is too expensive to play alongside Arc Reactor and Powered Gauntlets on Turn 1; dig for cheap Tech upgrades and resources.
Mulligan Tac Team: non-Tech cost-3 support cannot be played alongside both 2-cost Tech upgrades without a double resource; dig for 1-cost Tech upgrades or resources.
Keep Genius, Powered Gauntlets, and Arc Reactor: double resource plus two key 2-cost Tech upgrades for Turn 1 setup.

Clocks: T 0/3, +3 hero / +7 alter-ego; HP 9 vs incoming 5 (worst 10); win in 8 rounds, scheme lasts 6, HP lasts 2. Use Tony Stark's Futurist ability first to see 3 cards and draw 1 before playing upgrades.
Add Haymaker to hand to spend as the final resource needed to play all three Tech upgrades (Arc Reactor, Powered Gauntlets, Rocket Boots) this turn.
Build the board: play Rocket Boots (+1 HP and +1 Hero hand size Tech upgrade).
Pay for Rocket Boots with Emergency, keeping Genius and the other two Tech upgrades.
Build the board: play Powered Gauntlets (+1 Hero hand size and 1-2 damage per turn).
Pay for Powered Gauntlets with Supersonic Punch and Haymaker, saving Genius to pay for Arc Reactor.
Build the board: play Arc Reactor using Genius so Iron Man has 3 Tech upgrades (hand size 4) and can ready every turn.
Change to Iron Man: staying in alter-ego would advance The Crimson Cowl (0+7 >= 3), whereas flipping to Hero gives 4 hand size with 3 Tech upgrades, kills the Drone, and deals 2 damage to Ultron.
Use Powered Gauntlets to defeat the 1-HP Drone minion.
Target Drone with Powered Gauntlets to defeat it cleanly with 1 damage.
Use Iron Man's basic attack on Ultron for 1 damage before readying with Arc Reactor.
Use Arc Reactor to ready Iron Man for a second basic attack.
Use Iron Man's second basic attack on Ultron for 1 damage.
Defend with Iron Man: DEF (1) >= ATK (1), HP clock (p=2.5) is shorter than win clock (w=7), taking unblocked damage leaves HP below worst case, and Arc Reactor will still ready Iron Man next turn.

Choose 1 threat on the main scheme: scheme clock (s=5.7 across stages) has far more rounds left than HP clock (p=1.75 at 7 HP), spawning a Drone deals 1 immediate damage plus wastes Powered Gauntlets and mills our deck, and Mark V Helmet in hand removes 1 threat next turn.

Clocks: T 2/3, +3 hero / +7 alter-ego; HP 7 vs incoming 4 (worst 9); win in 6 rounds, scheme lasts 5, HP lasts 1.8. Play Mark V Helmet first to reach 4 Tech upgrades (hand size 5) and remove threat from the main scheme.
Pay for Mark V Helmet with Combat Training, keeping Nick Fury (mental) to activate Rocket Boots for Aerial and Hulk for next turn.
Use Rocket Boots with Nick Fury to gain Aerial so Powered Gauntlets deals 2 damage instead of 1.
Use Mark V Helmet to remove 1 threat from The Crimson Cowl.
Use Powered Gauntlets while Aerial to deal 2 damage to Ultron.
Use Arc Reactor to ready Iron Man.
Basic thwart The Crimson Cowl to 0 threat so it does not advance and we can safely choose +1 threat over a Drone after Ultron attacks.

Clocks: T 0/3, +3 hero / +7 alter-ego; HP 7 vs incoming 4 (worst 9); win in 6 rounds, scheme lasts 6, HP lasts 1.8. Stay in Hero form (alter-ego would auto-advance The Crimson Cowl due to Ultron's 2 SCH) and end turn so Iron Man readies to defend.
Keep Hulk for Turn 3 (cost 2, 3 ATK, 5 HP ally) and draw 4 cards up to hand size 5.
Defend with Iron Man: HP (7) is below worst case (9), HP clock (p=1.8) is shorter than win clock (w=5), DEF (1) >= ATK (1), and Arc Reactor will ready Iron Man next turn.
Choose 1 threat on the main scheme: The Crimson Cowl goes to 2/3 without advancing, whereas a Drone would immediately deal 1 damage when HP is down to 4 (p=1 << s=5.7).

Clocks: T 2/3, +3 hero / +7 alter-ego; HP 3 vs incoming 4 (worst 9); win in 4 rounds, scheme lasts 5, HP lasts 0.8. HP is in critical danger at 3, so first use Hero-only Tech upgrades (Mark V Helmet to set Stage 1 to 1/3 so Ultron's scheme wastes excess threat, Powered Gauntlets, Arc Reactor) before flipping to Tony Stark to recover.
Use Powered Gauntlets (Hero Action) to deal 1 damage to Ultron before flipping to Tony Stark.
Use Arc Reactor (Hero Action) to ready Iron Man before flipping to Tony Stark so Tony Stark can immediately recover 3 HP.
Change form to Tony Stark to recover 3 HP from critical 3 HP and use Futurist before playing cards.
Use Futurist first to look at the top 3 cards of our deck and draw 1 before choosing what to play.

Add Tigra to hand: she is an Aggression ally (discounted by The Power of Aggression so we can play both Tigra and Hulk this turn) and infinitely defeats 1-HP Ultron Drones while healing her consequential damage.
Recover 3 HP with Tony Stark (from 3 HP to 6 HP) before playing Hulk and attacking.
Play Hulk before Tigra so Hulk's attack trigger cannot damage Tigra if it reveals an energy resource.
Pay for Hulk with Combat Training and Repulsor Blast, keeping The Power of Aggression and Uppercut to play Tigra afterwards.
Attack Ultron with Hulk before playing Tigra so Tigra is protected if Hulk's deck discard has an energy resource.
Play Tigra so she can deal damage or thwart now and infinitely clear 1-HP Drones against Ultron.
Attack Ultron with Tigra for 2 damage: Ultron has 2 SCH so The Crimson Cowl advances during Ultron's scheme (wasting excess threat) whether at 1/3 or 0/3, making 2 damage strictly better.

Put a Drone into play rather than discarding an energy card from hand: in Alter-Ego the Drone deals 0 damage and only adds 1 threat to Assault on NORAD (2/10), Tigra and Relentless Assault easily clear Drones next turn, and we preserve our full hand to play Mark V Armor plus a second card.

Clocks: T 2/10, +5 hero / +11 alter-ego; HP 6 vs incoming 6 (worst 11); win in 4 rounds, scheme lasts 4.3, HP lasts 1. Use Futurist first in Alter-Ego before recovering, playing Mark V Armor, and flipping to Hero.
Add Uppercut to hand to use as the third resource so we can play both Mark V Armor and Tac Team this turn; all three cards will shuffle into the new deck at end of turn.
Use Tony Stark's basic recovery to heal 3 damage (6 -> 9 HP) before flipping to Iron Man and readying via Arc Reactor.
Play Mark V Armor for +6 HP (to 15/16 HP) and 5th Tech upgrade (Hero hand size 6).
Pay for Mark V Armor with First Aid, Relentless Assault, and Helicarrier, keeping Tac Team, The Power of Aggression, and Uppercut.

pay:Relentless Assault+Tac Team+The Power of Aggression
pay:First Aid+Relentless Assault+The Power of Aggression

choices.reasoning: Play Tac Team for 6 retaliate-ignoring damage over 3 rounds.
Change form to Iron Man (now 15/16 HP and hand size 6 with 5 Tech upgrades).
Have Tigra defeat Drone#40 so she heals 1 damage from her response.
Use Powered Gauntlets to defeat Drone#22 without triggering Ultron's Retaliate 1.
Target the remaining Drone with Powered Gauntlets to clear all minions.
Use Mark V Helmet to remove 1 threat from Assault on NORAD.
Use Arc Reactor to ready Iron Man.
Basic thwart Assault on NORAD to 0/10 (avoiding Ultron's Retaliate 1 and allowing us to take threat instead of Drones during the villain phase).

Use Tac Team to deal 2 retaliate-free damage to Ultron (down to 5 HP). Clocks at end of turn: T 0/10, +5 hero / +9 alter-ego; HP 15 vs incoming 4 (worst 9); win in 3 rounds, scheme lasts 4, HP lasts 3.8.

Place 2 threat on Assault on NORAD (now 3/10): scheme clock across stages (s=4.7) has more rounds left than HP clock (p=3.8), and Mark V Helmet plus Chase Them Down / Iron Man easily clears threat next turn.
Defend with Tigra (1 HP left, would die to consequential damage on her next action anyway) to soak all of Ultron's attack and keep Iron Man ready for next turn.

Place 1 threat on Assault on NORAD (now 4/10): scheme clock (s=4.0) still exceeds HP clock (p=3.8), Iron Man is ready with Arc Reactor and Mark V Helmet for up to 5 thwart next turn, and avoiding a Drone saves 1 HP and 1 deck card.

Clocks: T 7/10, +3 hero / +9 alter-ego; HP 15 vs incoming 5 (worst 10); win in 2 rounds, scheme lasts 2.7, HP lasts 3. First attack and defeat the Drone with Powered Gauntlets to trigger Chase Them Down and remove 2 threat from Assault on NORAD.
Attack Drone for 1 to defeat it and trigger Chase Them Down.
Play Chase Them Down for 0 cost to remove 2 threat from Assault on NORAD (7/10 -> 5/10).
Use Mark V Helmet to remove 1 threat from Assault on NORAD (5/10 -> 4/10).
Play second Powered Gauntlets to reach 6 Tech upgrades (maximum Hero hand size of 7) and deal 1-2 extra damage every turn.
Pay for Powered Gauntlets with Tenacity and Hulk, keeping Repulsor Blast and Rocket Boots to hit Ultron Stage II.
Use Tac Team for 2 retaliate-free damage on Stage I Ultron (5 -> 3 HP) so we finish Stage I cleanly before firing Repulsor Blast at Stage II.
Use second Powered Gauntlets to deal 1 damage to Stage I Ultron (3 -> 2 HP).
Basic attack Ultron for 1 damage (2 -> 1 HP).
Use Arc Reactor to ready Iron Man to finish Stage I Ultron cleanly.
Finish Stage I Ultron (1 HP left) with Iron Man's basic attack so zero damage is wasted before playing Repulsor Blast on Stage II.
Play Repulsor Blast onto Stage II Ultron (22 HP) to deal maximum damage before drawing up to our new 7-card hand size.
Clocks: T 4/10, +3 hero / +8 alter-ego; HP 12 vs incoming 6 (worst 12); win in 1.5 rounds, scheme lasts 3.7, HP lasts 2. Stay in Iron Man to draw 7 cards and ready Iron Man to defend.

Place 2 threat on Assault on NORAD (now 7/10): spawning a Drone against Stage II Ultron would add +2 incoming damage (+1 Ultron ATK and +1 Drone attack), whereas scheme clock across Stages 2 and 3 (s=3.3) exceeds HP clock (p=2.0) and we have near-guaranteed lethal next turn.

Defend with Iron Man: DEF (1) >= ATK (1), HP (12) equals worst case (12), and because Repulsor Blast deals odd damage (1, 3, 5...), Arc Reactor's 1 basic attack already gives 12 + 3 = 15 exact lethal on >=1 energy while 0 energy is non-lethal either way.

Clocks: T 7/10, +3 hero / +10 alter-ego; HP 9 vs incoming 8 (worst 15); win in 1 rounds, scheme lasts 2.7, HP lasts 1.1. Play Repulsor Blast targeting Ultron first to check for Turn 6 lethal (>=3 damage gives guaranteed lethal with Rocket Boots Aerial, two Powered Gauntlets, Tac Team, Arc Reactor, and Uppercut).
Pay for Repulsor Blast with Pepper Potts, keeping Stark Tower (mental for Rocket Boots), Uppercut, and Mockingbird.
Lethal sequence (Ultron at 10 HP): use Tac Team to deal 2 retaliate-free damage to Ultron (10 -> 8 HP).
Target Ultron with Tac Team for 2 damage (10 -> 8 HP).
Use Rocket Boots with Stark Tower to gain Aerial so both Powered Gauntlets deal 2 damage each.
Play Uppercut targeting Ultron for 5 damage (8 -> 3 HP).
Use first Powered Gauntlets while Aerial to deal 2 damage to Ultron (3 -> 1 HP).
Target Ultron with Powered Gauntlets for 2 damage (3 -> 1 HP).
Ready Iron Man with Arc Reactor to finish Ultron cleanly with 1 damage while keeping second Powered Gauntlets ready just in case.
Deal the final 1 damage to defeat Ultron!
